nodes.text: Visit The Wonderworks in Legion Dalaran and look for the Mad Merchant. Open his shop if he is present.

recovery.text: His presence is intermittent and the source gives no reliable schedule. Keep the goal followed and choose another activity if he is absent; do not show a spawn countdown.
